about_short_description.short_description: Canal is a distributed commerce platform that facilitates the retail or purchase of any product online.

product.name: Canal Marketplace Platform
product.description: A platform that enables retailers to source, manage, and sell third-party products through integrated partnerships and dropshipping.

product.name: Supplier Network and Discovery
product.description: A curated network of vetted brands and suppliers that retailers can access to source products for resale.

product.name: Dropshipping Management Tools
product.description: Tools within the platform that allow retailers and suppliers to manage dropshipping operations, including inventory sync, order flow, and fulfillment tracking.

product.name: API and Integration Services
product.description: API-driven integration services that connect Canal’s platform with various e-commerce backends, including Shopify and others.

product.name: Brand Partnership and Curation Support
product.description: Consultative services to help retailers and suppliers identify, negotiate, and implement brand partnerships effectively.
